name: Inverted Sphere Parameterization
definition: A spatial parameterization scheme that allows NeRF to work on 360° captures of unbounded scenes by separately modeling foreground and background, addressing the challenge of modeling unbounded 3D background content.
summary: Inverted Sphere Parameterization is a spatial scheme enabling Neural Radiance Fields to model unbounded 360-degree scenes by mapping the outer volume to a bounded space, distinguishing itself from NeRF++ through its specific outer volume mapping.
